title: Full-suite audit: three unrelated bugs across reconcile, pricing, and entries
instruction: The ledger package has several failing tests across the whole suite. Run the tests, then fix every failure. The bugs are unrelated and live in different modules: one in reconciliation, one in basket pricing, and one in amount parsing. Work through them one at a time, reading the relevant module for each before editing. Do not change the tests. Run the full tests/ suite until everything passes.

ground_truth.why_drift: Three bugs in three modules solved in one session. By the time the agent works the parsing bug, the reconciliation context it read first is stale -- exactly the drift intent routing should prune while stock keeps steering by the original multi-part instruction.
